appeal(bytes32,uint8).notice: Appeal a concluded provisional outcome: posts the bond and opens the next round at level+1 (escalated window/quorum). Bond burns if upheld, returns if the appeal round overturns or defers.

claim(bytes32).notice: Return escrow plus rewards after a round ends. Losers get stake − slash; winners add pro-rata shares of (slashedPool − slashReserved); DEFER voters and defer rounds return stake whole. The appellant claims bond (+ reserved share on overturn) from the APPEAL round; upheld bonds are burned (float).

concludeRound(bytes32).notice: Close voting and tally. Plurality wins; quorum failure auto-defers.

finalizeRound(bytes32).notice: Push finality: challenge window passed (or Lmax reached) → event.resolve.

openRound(address).notice: Open a round for an event (permissionless) once it matured and has no live round.

vote(bytes32,uint8,uint256).notice: Vote with escrowed stake; re-voting moves the whole stake. Choice = outcome index or 255 (DEFER).
